metadata.title: The Actualization Theory — A Reconstruction of Physics from Difference, Actualization and Spectrum (V2.2, New Physics Program)
metadata.description: The Actualization Theory (AT, formerly THE Q-MODEL) reconstructs physics from the primitive Difference and the tensor reference eta through the hierarchy Difference -> Actualization -> Inevitable Spectrum -> Physics, with the D96 spectrum as the source of quantum mechanics, gravity, standard-model observables and cosmology. Its central claim is the structure/content split: the form of observable structure (topology, symmetry, distribution shape, lower bounds) is provable from the primitives, while the content (masses, couplings, multiplicities, angles) is a contingent draw, classified rather than derived. Version 2.1 closed the origin chain end to end, leaving exactly five irreducible boundaries: {Difference, eta}, the Z2-paired (complex) sector, the three octave families, {SU(2) gauge, j = 1/2}, and {v, m_e}. Version 2.2 is the New Physics program (172 audits, NP_001-NP_175); it established that no AT-specific observable remains and formally closed the lock-lattice physical-realizability program. In parallel it extended the gravity/time audits (G_021-G_036) and opened an electromagnetism group (E_001), whose headline results are deliberately negative and are recorded in full: the derived spatial structure is excluded by measurement (the conformal form gives gamma = -1, i.e. zero light bending, refuted by Cassini at 8.6957e4 sigma); the spatial sector cannot be derived (G_030 no-go) and closes instead on the postulate g_rr = 2 - rho^(2/d), which reproduces gamma = +1; and the electromagnetic dynamics is declared but never computed (E_001), with the sourced Maxwell equation and any spin-1 wave equation absent, alpha self-contradictory, and U(1) carrying two incompatible origins. Also resolved: light bending requires the spatial half, since time dilation alone gives exactly half the observed deflection and is excluded at 43,479 sigma. Publication status: the ARCHIVED, CITABLE ARTIFACT REMAINS THE V2.0 MONOGRAPH (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20681734); V2.2 adds no publication artifact and has no deposit of its own.
metadata.notes: V2.2 (2026-09-13) is a research release: audit lines complete, NOT yet tagged, and NO Zenodo deposit. The archived, citable monograph remains V2.0 under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20681734. Monograph text: CC-BY-4.0; code: MIT. V2.2 records three negative headline results honestly (a refuted spatial structure, a no-go theorem, and a declared-but-uncomputed electromagnetic dynamics) alongside one resolution (light bending requires the spatial sector). Before tagging, two items are recommended: re-run the G_027/G_033/G_035 source scanners with AtSourceScan (their per-line stripping counted multi-line verbatim-string prose as code), and fix the D_ResonanceStructure full-suite hang recorded in AT.Tests/TestResults since 2026-09-01. See Docs/Publication/RELEASE_NOTES_V2_2.md.
